Sign catalogue

Sign

M210

Looks like: tall triangle with vertical divider, horizontal hatching throughout, either isosceles or more horn-shaped

From the field-cady sign descriptions (Parpola 209). This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Wells W501 · Unclassified

Appears in 8 texts (22 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; found at the start, middle and end of texts. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W501 is in 3 texts.

Where it appears 8

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 22 objects in all carry it.
